slides.title: THE CENTRAL DOGMA
slides.note: Transcribe means copy the same language (DNA to RNA). Translate means change language (nucleotides to amino acids).

slides.title: TRANSCRIPTION
slides.problem: Template strand: 3′ TAC GGA 5′. What is the mRNA?

slides.title: TRANSLATION

steps: Ribosome reads 3 bases at a time

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: In eukaryotes, transcription is in the nucleus. Translation is at ribosomes in the cytoplasm.

pageTitle: Transcription vs Translation: Differences and Worked Examples
description: Transcription copies DNA into mRNA; translation turns mRNA into protein. See both with worked examples.
